ctx.x: Really. So I dedicated this one, "Midnight With Sampson", and Victor released it. Then another thing I had, "Number Three." I used to write so many Blues-type tunes, I'd just put numbers on them, and this one was called "Number Three." And "(?) and Company." Then I also did "Pastel." That was released on Victor. I had forgotten that one, too. Then "Hollywood Drive" and "Early Times", "Lonesome Rebecca." And one that I really wish they had released was a Mississippi Blues, which would be good even now.
